title: Mai Shelar Babban Rigyawa
intro: Wannan mutum ya tsaya a matsayin ginshiƙin juriya tsawon ƙarnoni, yana kiran al'umma mai tawaye zuwa ga hasken gaskiya yayin da yake fuskantar izgili da ƙin yarda. Duk da ƙalubale masu yawa da nauyin saƙo da ya mamaye tsararraki, wannan bawan ya ci gaba da dagewa a kan manufarsa har sai da aka fitar da hukunci na ƙarshe.
clues: Na shafe shekaru ɗari tara da hamsin ina kiran mutanena zuwa ga tafarkin adalci, dare da rana, a ɓoye da kuma a bainar jama'a.
Na yi wa mutanena gargaɗi game da azaba mai radadi, duk da haka suka sanya yatsunsu a cikin kunnuwansu suka lulluɓe kansu da tufafinsu cikin girman kai.
An umarce ni da in gina wani babban abu a ƙarƙashin idanun Ubangijina, duk da cewa babu ruwa a wurin.
Yayin da nake aiki, shugabannin mutanena suna wucewa suna yi mini ba'a, amma na gaya musu cewa nan ba da jimawa ba za mu zama waɗanda ke yi musu ba'a.
Na roƙi nama da jinina su haɗu da ni, amma suka zaɓi neman mafaka a kan dutse, suna tsammanin zai cece su daga ambaliyar ruwa.
Jirgin ruwa na ya tsaya a kan Dutsen Judi bayan da ƙasa ta haɗiye ruwanta kuma sama ta daina zubar da ruwan.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
